sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Tests: sticky-page-headers.spec.js's annotation test no longer fails on its own premise. Its click on the Annotation heading scrolls that element into view, and on a page wider than the window that scroll can move the page sideways by a few pixels, depending on how far the layout has settled; the test then failed on "the page starts at scrollX 0" (Expected: 0, Received: 6) before anything it checks — the one-off merge-gate failure seen three times since 9.99.1276. It now returns the page to its left edge after the click (toLeftEdge()). Reproduced on demand by nudging the page 6 px after the click: failed before the fix, passes after. No change for users.
